narrative: Strait of Hormuz tension dominates weekend headlines following a naval mine tanker fire and missile strikes, setting up a safe-haven dollar bid for the Tokyo open while VIX at 35.9 signals severe broad risk aversion. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.0975, facing downside pressure as widening rate differentials favor USD ahead of upcoming Euro Area PMI releases. AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.6619 and faces further risk-off headwinds as the weakest G10 currency. USD/JPY closed Friday at 158.51, where potential safe-haven JPY flows would pressure the pair from its Friday close ahead of Tuesday's US Consumer Confidence report.
